Use case: style-transfer.
Input image 1 is the complete registered 3D phase atlas EDIT TARGET, including transparent canvas space. Improve the surface art on every panel while retaining the useful modeled raised terrain shape. Keep the full 128x128 runtime square base, the 32px visible front-wall height, straight parallel edges, and every block's exact position and size. The top face is a screen-aligned square, shifted upward by 32px over its ground square; the front face below it is a 128x32 rectangle. Do not turn the square into a diamond, round the base, add a separate rim, or grow a splash beyond the block.
Camera: fixed top-down oblique square-grid front-facing three-quarter projection; no perspective or camera rotation. Texture/artwork may be polished, but useful outer geometry and square coverage stay intact.
Preserve the COMPLETE 864x1024 canvas, all 12 panels in FOUR columns by THREE rows, row-major phase order, and all transparent space/gutters. Each unchanged full panel is 192x320; panel lefts 0,224,448,672 and tops 0,352,704. Within EACH panel the block occupies x32 through160, top at y152, front begins y280, base ends y312; the ground root stays (96,248). Keep all those nominal extents in the reference's proportions if the tool uses one uniform whole-canvas output scale. Do not recenter, repack, zoom, crop, fit or rearrange anything.
Return genuine transparent background outside complete blocks and gutters. The entire top and front are opaque artwork, including at the base edges. No ground/floor outside the block, no labels, no external glow, no cast shadow, no isolated debris.
Surface subject: a finished illustrated moving lava field using the supplied authored flow phases as the motion scaffold. Add natural charcoal crust texture and richly painted yellow-orange molten channels while retaining a clear horizontal surface flow through all twelve successive row-major phases at 12 fps. Keep phase zero's block complete even where the reference surface is dark. Make a coherent one-second cyclic drift with channel features traveling through the sequence; phase eleven must flow smoothly into phase zero.
This case specifically requires visibly moving surface features and connected neighboring surfaces, including offset-phase neighbors. Continue compatible channel/color detail across opposite edges for ALL phases without stationary edge bands, a dark border, a bright border outline, or a per-tile brightness gradient. Keep average illumination steady. The front wall remains the same opaque 128x32 rectangle, with darker coordinated lava detail. Paint heat glow inside the tile, not outside the modeled block.
